messages:
olivia: Auditor Mike requested a minimal evidence packet for the RBAC narrowing on service-account-embedder (2025-11-15) plus KMS decrypt events tied to that change. Need: approval trail, kube audit excerpt, signed KMS export, and a one-page control mapping. Can we get this by EOD?

Tom_sec: I have the approval record in JIRA SEC-4120 and the reviewer checklist. PR is infra/iam#1589, commit f1e2d3. The change removed broad compute roles and granted a custom role with kms.decrypt only.

Rachel_dev: GitOps applied the RoleBinding at 2025-11-15T07:42:03Z. Kube audit shows the update; CI job shows deploy at 07:42:30Z. I'll paste a sanitized snippet into the runbook.

secbot: evidence-run: started job ev-20251115-033; collecting artifacts: JIRA/SEC-4120, commit/f1e2d3, kube-audit-snippet, kms-export. Progress: 0/4.

auditor_mike: Quick clarifications: 1) Signed machine-readable KMS export (JSON) + checksum (sha256) and detached GPG sig. 2) Chain-of-custody: who exported, timestamp, storage location. 3) Map each artifact to SOC2 control CC-3.2 and CC-6.1 and ISO A.9.4. Also want statement that KMS key policy restricts decrypt to service-account-embedder.

ops-ryan: I'll run the export for a 2-hour window around the change and sign. Commands I used: 

```bash
# export decrypt events
gcloud logging read 'resource.type='cloud_kms_key' AND protoPayload.methodName='Decrypt' AND timestamp>="2025-11-15T06:30:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-11-15T08:30:00Z"' --format=json > /tmp/kms-20251115.json
# checksum and sign
sha256sum /tmp/kms-20251115.json > /tmp/kms-20251115.json.sha256
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-20251115.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-20251115.json
# upload to evidence bucket
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251115.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-11-15/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251115.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-11-15/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20251115.json.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-11-15/
```

Tom_sec: KMS key policy snapshot (HSM-backed) shows only the new custom role and ops service account permitted to decrypt. I'll attach the policy diff.

secbot: evidence-run: progress 2/4 (JIRA/SEC-4120, commit/f1e2d3 added).

Rachel_dev: Sanitized kube audit snippet (to include in runbook):

`{verb: update, objectRef: {resource: rolebinding, name: embedder-bind}, user: gitops-bot@redwood}`

ops-ryan: Uploaded signed export and checksum to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-11-15/embedder-kms-2795550001.json (files: .json, .sig, .sha256). SHA256: 5b8f3c2a9e4d6f7a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4. I notarized the sha256 in our timestamp service (NT-20251115-09).

auditor_mike: Please include signature fingerprint and notary ticket in the runbook. Also include a 2-line statement that logs-retention-policy-v2 retains events 395 days and evidence bucket enforces write-once snapshots for 7 days.

Tom_sec: Noted. I'll produce a one-page runbook mapping artifacts to controls (SEC-4120 -> CC-3.2 change control; kms-export -> CC-6.1 logging; KMS policy snapshot -> ISO A.9.4 access rights).

secbot: evidence-run: completed. job ev-20251115-033 status=success artifacts=4

ops-ryan: Presigned bundle URL (7d): https://presigned.s3.redwood/evidence/2025-11-15/embedder-bundle-2795550001.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. GPG key fingerprint: 0x7F3A9C1B. Notary NT-20251115-09.

auditor_mike: Received. Auditor will confirm and may ask for three raw log lines for hash verification. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

olivia: Sending the runbook + presigned link to auditor. Closing thread after audit ack. :white_check_mark:
